fail.note: A PrimJS limit, kept for speed (core-js's Object.assign is 5 to 7.5 times slower on PrimJS; the README's known limits): PrimJS's Object.assign copies nothing onto an array from a Proxy source whose ownKeys lists keys its target lacks, giving [] where the standard gives [, 9]. It also copies a key a getter made non-enumerable during the copy, which no test here checks.
